place.en: The hidden realm · The stone chamber

setup.zh: 第二天夜里，你埋在土里，隔着那道墙，听见了外头崖壁上的声音。六个人贴在崖上，一天一夜没吃没喝。
setup.en: On the second night, buried in the earth, you hear sounds on the cliff outside, through the wall. Six people stuck to the rock, a day and a night without food or water.

recap.zh: 第二夜，马小宝看出来：阵粘住的是老蔫的袄子，人没粘死。他拿「你爹那三亩坡田，是谁家的？」逼着老蔫脱了袄子往上爬，喊人，拿绳子。老蔫冲着墙喊了一声「沈小满——」。你埋在息壤里，土一破，长了一半的地就是一块烂泥；你没有动。他爬到第十九下，没扒住，掉进了凶崖。
recap.en: On the second night Ma Xiaobao saw it: the binding held Old Wilt's jacket, not Old Wilt. With "Those three mu of hillside your father farms — whose are they?" he forced Old Wilt out of the jacket to climb up, call for help, fetch a rope. Old Wilt called once at the wall: "Shen Xiaoman —" You were buried in the living soil; break the earth and the half-grown ground would be so much mud. You did not move. At the nineteenth handhold he lost his grip and fell into the Cliff of Danger.

zh: 第二天夜里，隔着那道墙。
en: The second night, through the wall.
"Those three mu of hillside your father farms — whose are they?"

story.zh:
第二天夜里，他埋在土里，隔着那道墙，听见了外头崖壁上的声音。到了第二天夜里，骂声没了，只剩下喘。

马小宝的声音，饿得又哑又低：「……老蔫。你的手，动了。」马小宝又道：「你把袄子脱了，能出来。」老蔫的声音，比蚊子还细：「宝哥……崖是凉的，我手……没知觉了。」马小宝的声音忽然换了一副腔调，平平的：「你爹那三亩坡田，是谁家的？」

崖上再没有一个人说话。

过了一会儿，小满听见布料撕开的声音，很慢，「嘶——」。跟着，墙外头响起一个声音，不高，却清清楚楚，是冲着这面墙喊的：

「沈小满——」只喊了这一声。
story.en:
On the second night, buried in the earth, he heard through the wall the sounds on the cliff outside. By the second night there was no more swearing, only panting.

Ma Xiaobao's voice, low and hoarse with hunger: "...Old Wilt. Your hand moved." Ma Xiaobao said again: "Take the jacket off and you can get out." Old Wilt's voice, fainter than a mosquito: "Brother Bao... the cliff's cold, my hands... I can't feel them." Ma Xiaobao's voice suddenly changed its tone: flat, not hoarse any more. "Your pa's three mu of hillside field. Whose are they?"

Nobody on the cliff said another word.

After a while Xiaoman heard cloth tearing, very slowly, *rrrip*. Then from outside the wall came a voice, not loud but perfectly clear, calling to this wall:

"Shen Xiaoman—" It called only that once.

story_full.zh:
第二天夜里，他埋在土里，隔着那道墙，听见了外头崖壁上的声音。

头一天，崖上还骂，还哭，还有人拿脑袋撞石头；到了第二天夜里，骂声没了，只剩下喘。冬月的秘境，崖壁凉得透骨，六个人贴在上头，一天一夜没吃没喝，只拿舌头去舔崖上渗下来的那一线水。小满埋在墙里头那座土丘里，那一圈五行转得正匀，外头每一声喘，他都听得见。

先是马小宝的声音，饿得又哑又低：「……老蔫。你的手，动了。」

没有人应。马小宝又道：「老蔫。你那件袄子是粘在石头上的，人没粘死——你把袄子脱了，能出来。」隔了很久，老蔫的声音，比蚊子还细：「宝哥……崖是凉的，我手……没知觉了。」马小宝道：「爬上去，喊人，拿绳子来。三天？他说三天就三天？这阵要是不松呢？」又隔了很久，马小宝的声音忽然换了一副腔调，平平的，不哑了，像他爹马三在村口收租：「你爹那三亩坡田，是谁家的？」

崖上再没有一个人说话。

过了一会儿，小满听见布料撕开的声音，很慢，「嘶——」，一寸一寸，像有人在揭一张贴死在墙上的旧年画。撕完了，静了一静。跟着，墙外头响起一个声音，不高，却清清楚楚，是冲着这面墙喊的：

「沈小满——」

只喊了这一声。
story_full.en:
On the second night, buried in the earth, he heard through the wall the sounds on the cliff outside.

On the first day there was still swearing on the cliff, still crying, and someone knocking his head against the rock. By the second night there was no more swearing, only panting. A secret realm in the eleventh month: the cliff was cold to the bone, and the six stuck on it had had nothing to eat or drink for a day and a night, only their tongues to lick the thread of water seeping down the cliff. Xiaoman, buried in the mound of earth inside the wall, the round of the five phases turning just evenly, could hear every breath outside.

First Ma Xiaobao's voice, low and hoarse with hunger: "...Old Wilt. Your hand moved."

Nobody answered. Ma Xiaobao said again: "Old Wilt. It's your jacket that's stuck to the rock, not you. Take the jacket off and you can get out." After a long time, Old Wilt's voice, fainter than a mosquito: "Brother Bao... the cliff's cold, my hands... I can't feel them." Ma Xiaobao said: "Climb up, shout for someone, get a rope. Three days? If he says three days it's three days? What if the array doesn't let go?" After another long time, Ma Xiaobao's voice suddenly changed its tone: flat, not hoarse any more, like his father Ma San collecting rent at the village gate. "Your pa's three mu of hillside field. Whose are they?"

Nobody on the cliff said another word.

After a while Xiaoman heard cloth tearing, very slowly, *rrrip*, inch by inch, like someone peeling off an old New Year picture stuck fast to a wall. When it was done there was a moment's quiet. Then from outside the wall came a voice, not loud but perfectly clear, calling to this wall:

"Shen Xiaoman—"

It called only that once.

exits.means: stays buried in the breathing-soil mound inside the wall while Old Wilt climbs and falls — standing would tear the half-grown roots; does not open the binding

story.zh:
小满埋在土里，两只手按在膝盖上，指甲掐进了肉里。他只要从土里站起来——土一破，那些须子便断在半路。他没有动。

墙外头，响起了一下一下往上爬的声音。小满数着。数到第十九下，那声音停了。然后是一声惨叫，很长，很长，越掉越远，越掉越细，细成一根线，断了。

第三天天快亮，再吸半天，第五层的门槛也许便摸得着了。一个很困的声音在他耳朵里道：「够了。」小满道：「还没够。再吸半天，就五层了。」那声音道：「……你娘给你起的名字，叫什么？」

满了就要溢出来，溢出来就糟践了；饱了一点，还没满，还知道饿。知道饿，才知道别人也饿。他慢慢地，把那口还没吸完的气吐了出去。隔着那面墙，传来马小宝的声音：「……沈小满。你在里头喘气，我听得见。」

那座土丘「喀」地裂开了。息壤，都长进了他身子里。石壁里照出一个人影——那人影的皮肤底下，有光。五种颜色，像五条小河。换了昨天，他该咧着嘴笑。这时候他只觉得嘴里发苦。
story.en:
Xiaoman was buried in the earth, both hands on his knees, his nails digging into his flesh. He had only to stand up out of the earth. But break the earth and those roots would snap halfway. He didn't move.

Outside the wall came the sound of climbing, one pull at a time. Xiaoman counted. At nineteen, the sound stopped. Then a scream, long, long, further and further, thinner and thinner, thin as a thread, and then it broke.

Near dawn on the third day: half a day more of drawing it in, and he might touch the threshold of the fifth layer. A very sleepy voice said in his ear: "Enough." Xiaoman said: "Not enough yet. Half a day more and it's the fifth layer." The voice said: "...The name your mother gave you. What is it?"

When a thing's full it spills over, and what spills is wasted; a little fed, not yet full, you still know hunger. Knowing hunger is how you know other people are hungry. Slowly, he let out the breath he hadn't finished drawing. Through the wall came Ma Xiaobao's voice: "...Shen Xiaoman. I can hear you breathing in there."

The mound of earth split open with a *crack*. The living soil had all grown into his body. In the wall was a reflection. And under that reflection's skin there was light. Five colours, like five little rivers. Yesterday he'd have grinned at this. Now there was only a bitter taste in his mouth.

story_full.zh:
小满埋在土里，土齐着胸口，两只手按在膝盖上，指甲掐进了肉里。他只要从土里站起来——土一破，那些须子便断在半路，长了一半的地，就是一块烂泥。那一圈五行在他身子里转着，转得又匀又快，他没有动。

墙外头，响起了一下一下往上爬的声音，指甲刮着石头，很慢，隔很久，一下；又隔很久，一下。小满数着。数到第十九下，那声音停了。

然后是一声惨叫，很长，很长，从崖上往下掉，掉过了那道石台，掉进了石台外头那一片黑里，越掉越远，越掉越细，细成一根线，断了。

隔了很久很久，底下传上来一声。很轻，像一滴水。

崖上一个声音也没有。墙里头，小满埋在土里，一动不动，那一圈五行还在他身子里转，他却觉得冷，冷得牙齿磕着牙齿。

第三天天快亮，石室里的灵气还厚着。再吸半天，第五层的门槛也许便摸得着了。他便又吸了一口。这一口吸下去，他觉出不对来了：丹田里那一圈转，慢了，沉了，像灶膛里柴塞得太满，火闷住了，只冒烟，不起焰；他再吸，那灵气便在经脉里堵着，胀得他胸口发闷，太阳穴一跳一跳地疼。

一个很困的声音在他耳朵里道：「够了。」小满道：「还没够。再吸半天，就五层了。」那声音道：「……你娘给你起的名字，叫什么？」小满愣了一愣。他想起过年那天夜里，他娘拨着算盘，给他讲他这个名字：满了就要溢出来，溢出来就糟践了；饱了一点，还没满，还知道饿。知道饿，才知道别人也饿。他慢慢地，把那口还没吸完的气吐了出去。吐出去的那一刻，胸口一松，像从塞满的灶膛里抽出一根柴，风钻进去，火苗子「呼」地蹿了起来——那一圈又转了，转得轻快，匀匀的。石室里的灵气还厚厚地积着，他只舀走了浅浅的一层；剩下的，留给它自己。便在这时，隔着那面墙，崖壁上传来马小宝的声音，饿得又哑又低，却一个字一个字地钻进来：「……沈小满。你在里头喘气，我听得见。」

那座土丘「喀」地裂开了。他从土里爬出来，身后留下一个坐出来的窝。剩下的土，已经是寻常的土了；息壤，都长进了他身子里。他趴到墙角，把那道细泉喝了一口，甜得发腻。青石地上，掉了几粒土渣的地方，冒出了一根青芽。这一屋子里，只这一点绿。

他走到那面光溜溜的石壁跟前，石壁里照出一个人影，蓬着头，一脸的泥和血——那人影的皮肤底下，有光。金白的，青的，黑的，红的，黄的，五种颜色，一道一道，像五条小河，从心口流到手指尖，又流回来。杂灵根，那三个字，是执事拖长了调子念的。换了昨天，他该咧着嘴笑。这时候他只觉得嘴里发苦。他把那只赤铜葫芦掏出来握着，葫芦肚里一点一点温了起来——他五扇门里，有一扇是火。包袱里还剩一根萝卜，他啃了。
story_full.en:
Xiaoman was buried in the earth up to his chest, both hands on his knees, his nails digging into his flesh. He had only to stand up out of the earth. But break the earth and those roots would snap halfway, and the half-grown ground would be a patch of mud. The round of the five phases turned in his body, even and fast. He didn't move.

Outside the wall came the sound of climbing, one pull at a time, fingernails scraping rock, very slow: a long gap, one; a long gap, one. Xiaoman counted. At nineteen, the sound stopped.

Then a scream, long, long, falling from the cliff, falling past the ledge, falling into the dark beyond the ledge, further and further, thinner and thinner, thin as a thread, and then it broke.

After a long, long time a sound came up from below. Very faint, like a drop of water.

Not a sound on the cliff. Inside the wall, Xiaoman sat buried in the earth without moving. The round of the five phases still turned in him, but he felt cold, so cold his teeth knocked together.

Near dawn on the third day the spirit qi in the chamber was still thick. Half a day more of drawing it in, and he might touch the threshold of the fifth layer. So he drew another breath. As this breath went in, he felt something was wrong: the round in his dantian had gone slow and heavy, like a stove stuffed too full of wood so the fire chokes and only smokes and won't flame. He drew again, and the spirit qi jammed in his meridians, swelling until his chest was tight and his temples throbbed with pain.

A very sleepy voice said in his ear: "Enough." Xiaoman said: "Not enough yet. Half a day more and it's the fifth layer." The voice said: "...The name your mother gave you. What is it?" Xiaoman was taken aback. He remembered New Year's night, his mother clicking her abacus and telling him about his name: when a thing's full it spills over, and what spills is wasted; a little fed, not yet full, you still know hunger. Knowing hunger is how you know other people are hungry. Slowly, he let out the breath he hadn't finished drawing. As it went out, his chest eased, like pulling one stick out of a stuffed stove: air got in, and the flames leapt up with a *whoosh*. The round turned again, light and quick and even. The spirit qi lay thick in the chamber still; he'd only scooped off a shallow layer. The rest he left to itself. Just then, through the wall, came Ma Xiaobao's voice from the cliff, low and hoarse with hunger, but every word getting through: "...Shen Xiaoman. I can hear you breathing in there."

The mound of earth split open with a *crack*. He climbed out of it, leaving behind him a hollow where he'd sat. The earth that was left was ordinary earth now; the living soil had all grown into his body. He crawled to the corner and drank a mouthful from the thin spring, sweet to the point of cloying. On the bluestone floor, where a few crumbs of earth had fallen, a green shoot had come up. In the whole room, that was the only bit of green.

He went to the smooth stone wall, and in it was a reflection: tousled hair, a face covered with mud and blood. And under that reflection's skin there was light. Gold-white, green, black, red, yellow, five colours, streak by streak, like five little rivers flowing from the heart to the fingertips and back. *Mixed spirit root*: those words the steward had drawn out long. Yesterday he'd have grinned at this. Now there was only a bitter taste in his mouth. He took out the red-copper gourd and held it, and the belly of the gourd warmed little by little: of his five doors, one was fire. There was one radish left in his bundle. He ate it.

exits._grant: 古五 (2026-10-02): the bead he closed his hand on in a crack below the wind shaft, climbing back with the knife in his teeth (wm-xirang's passage) — handed over here, a scene later, because wm-xirang's exit already grants the knife and a grant carries one item.
